args.expression: (async()=>{const wait=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const visible=e=>!!e&&getComputedStyle(e).display!=='none'&&getComputedStyle(e).visibility!=='hidden'&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0&&e.getBoundingClientRect().height>0;const q=s=>document.querySelector(s);if(visible(q('#logoutBtn'))){q('#logoutBtn').click();await wait(200);}const fill=(e,p)=>{q('#email').value=e;q('#password').value=p;for(const s of ['#email','#password'])q(s).dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));};fill('invalid-email','password123');q('#loginBtn').click();await wait(200);const invalid={typeMismatch:q('#email').validity.typeMismatch,validationMessage:q('#email').validationMessage,loginFormVisible:visible(q('#loginForm')),userInfoVisible:visible(q('#userInfo'))};const observed=[];const originalAlert=window.alert;let wrong;try{window.alert=function(message){observed.push(String(message));return originalAlert.call(window,message);};fill('test@example.com','wrongpassword');q('#loginBtn').click();await wait(1000);wrong={observedAlertMessages:observed,loginFormVisible:visible(q('#loginForm')),userInfoVisible:visible(q('#userInfo'))};}finally{window.alert=originalAlert;}return{invalidEmail:invalid,wrongPassword:wrong,alertRestored:window.alert===originalAlert};})()
